# Security and Privacy Checklist: Project Foundation

**Purpose**: Validate that the security and privacy requirements in spec.md are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before planning. Covers RBAC, audit completeness, secrets handling, webhook verification, idempotency, log redaction, PHI guard coverage (UI, API, storage, logs, LLM prompts) and data retention.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## RBAC and Access Control

- [x] CHK001 Are the permissions held by each of the seven roles defined, or is the deferral to later features explicit enough to be testable for this feature's own endpoints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Is "least privilege" expressed as a measurable rule (for example, deny by default plus an enumerated permission list) rather than as a principle only? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Is the point at which a role change takes effect specified as a requirement (not only as an acceptance scenario), including for sessions already in progress? [Gap, Spec §User Story 1 scenario 5]
- [x] CHK004 Are the invitation lifecycle rules defined: expiry, re-invitation, and revocation of an unaccepted invitation? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is session lifetime, idle timeout and sign-out behaviour specified, given that the identity provider outage edge case relies on "valid sessions continue until expiry"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Are the requirements for who may review and release quarantined content consistent between "authorised reviewer" (US3), "explicitly authorised roles" (FR-020) and "administrators only" (Assumptions)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Does FR-009 define how an "automated or AI actor" is identified so the restriction is verifiable, and does it cover service accounts and jobs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are server-side enforcement requirements stated for every entry point (API, jobs, webhooks), not only user-facing actions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behaviour defined when an administrator changes their own roles or deactivates themselves, beyond the "last administrator" rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for the first administrator's bootstrap (how the initial administrator is created without an existing administrator)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Audit Completeness

- [x] CHK011 Is "state-changing action" defined precisely enough to enumerate which actions must be audited, including system-initiated changes by jobs and webhooks? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Is the content of the "before/after summary" specified (fields included, maximum size, how it is redacted) so two reviewers would produce the same result? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Are sign-in, sign-out and failed sign-in events included in the audit requirements, or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, FR-011]
- [x] CHK014 Is reading of sensitive records (quarantine items, failed-job details) covered by an audit requirement consistently, not only quarantine access? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, FR-026]
- [x] CHK015 Does the requirement that a change cannot commit without its audit event (FR-013) state the user-visible behaviour and the interaction with job retries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK016 Is the append-only rule (FR-012) reconciled with any retention and deletion obligation for audit events? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Is tamper-evidence (not just prevention of edits through the application) a stated requirement or a stated exclusion? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK018 Is it specified who may view or export audit events? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities: Audit Event]

## Secrets Handling

- [x] CHK019 Is "secret" defined (credentials, API keys, signing secrets, tokens) so FR-014, FR-034 and FR-048 apply to the same set? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, FR-034, FR-048]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how secrets are supplied to deployed environments and kept out of the repository, beyond "no secrets in the repository"? [Gap, Spec §FR-048]
- [x] CHK021 Are secret rotation and revocation requirements specified for webhook signing secrets and provider credentials? [Gap, Spec §FR-029, FR-036]
- [x] CHK022 Is it specified how a Provider Connection stores or references credentials without exposing them in the interface, logs or audit events? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities: Provider Connection]
- [x] CHK023 Is the test-suite requirement for seeded secrets (FR-035) accompanied by a definition of the seeded secret set and how completeness of the seeds is judged? [Measurability, Spec §FR-035, SC-006]

## Webhook Verification

- [x] CHK024 Is "not-verifiable" source behaviour defined: who may configure it, what "flagged" means, and what is prohibited from being processed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK025 Do FR-029 (store raw first, before any processing) and FR-032 / US5 scenario 6 (block PHI before processing, raw copy not retained in clear) conflict, and is the order of guard, storage and verification stated? [Conflict, Spec §FR-029, FR-032]
- [x] CHK026 Are the timestamp skew window and payload size limit given default values or an explicit statement that the plan will set them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, FR-049, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 Is the scope of "delivery ID" uniqueness defined (per source, global) and the behaviour for a replayed delivery whose first attempt failed verification? [Gap, Spec §FR-030, User Story 5]
- [x] CHK028 Are the requirements for responses to the sender (accept, reject, duplicate) defined so retries by the sender cannot cause repeated processing? [Gap, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK029 Is unauthenticated or abusive webhook traffic (rate limits, unknown sources) addressed in the requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-031]

## Idempotency

- [x] CHK030 Is the idempotency key's scope, origin (caller-supplied or derived) and lifetime defined for jobs? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK031 Is the behaviour defined when the same key is submitted with different payloads? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK032 Is "single execution" defined for concurrent submissions and for a retry after partial completion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, SC-003]
- [x] CHK033 Are idempotency requirements for state-changing API requests (not only jobs and webhooks) stated or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap]

## Log Redaction and Observability

- [x] CHK034 Is "sensitive fields" defined by classification or by an enumerated list so redaction scope is objective? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK035 Do redaction requirements cover all outputs, including error messages, job error details, audit summaries, health responses and traces, consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, FR-026, FR-034, FR-044]
- [x] CHK036 Is the log-scan requirement (FR-035) limited to test output, and is there a stated requirement for deployed-environment logs? [Gap, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK037 Is correlation-ID validation defined ("well-formed" accepted, "malformed" replaced) with a format and length rule so it cannot be used for log injection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, User Story 6 scenario 2]

## PHI Guard Coverage

- [x] CHK038 Are entry points enumerated for the guard (API, uploads, webhooks, UI input, background-job inputs, provider responses), and is the user interface covered by a requirement as the user asked? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK039 Are "adjacent to a name" (MRN, DOB) and "tabular patient-style rows" defined precisely enough for different reviewers to classify a sample identically? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK040 Is the list of detector patterns presented as minimum ("including") or complete, and is a process for adding detectors specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, FR-018]
- [x] CHK041 Are acceptable false-negative and false-positive rates (or the evidence needed to accept the detector set) stated as measurable criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, FR-022]
- [x] CHK042 Is the choice between reject and quarantine defined as a rule (by source, by confidence) rather than left to implementation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK043 Are storage requirements defined for data at rest, including how already-stored content is protected if a detector is added or improved later? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK044 Is the guard requirement for language-model prompts consistent between FR-039 (all provider payloads) and FR-043 (refusal of flagged input), including model outputs fed back as input? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039, FR-043]
- [x] CHK045 Does the spec state that provider responses and generated model output are also inspected before storage or display? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK046 Are log and audit protections consistent with the guard (content blocked is never written even in diagnostic or debug modes)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, FR-034, FR-041]
- [x] CHK047 Is the operator notification in FR-019 defined (recipient, channel, content limits, rate) so it does not itself leak suspected PHI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK048 Are requirements defined for credentials detected in content (the guard treats credentials as prohibited, but detector patterns listed are PHI-only)? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, FR-017]

## Data Retention and Privacy

- [x] CHK049 Are retention periods stated as requirements for audit events, AI invocation records, webhook raw payloads, quarantine items and failed-job details, rather than only as assumptions for some of them? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK050 Are deletion and purge requirements defined for each retention period, including how deletion is reconciled with append-only audit events? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK051 Is the disposition and maximum holding time of quarantined content specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK052 Is business-contact data minimisation addressed for user records (collection limited to what is needed for sign-in and role assignment)? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities: User]
- [x] CHK053 Are encryption in transit and at rest required, as stated in the constitution's Security Baseline, and are they traceable to a requirement or success criterion? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK054 Are the retention assumptions explicitly marked as pending confirmation by the privacy lead, with an owner and a place they are tracked? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Likely real spec defects surfaced while writing items (worth fixing in `/speckit-clarify`): CHK025 (raw-first storage versus PHI blocking), CHK006 (who reviews quarantine), CHK016 and CHK050 (append-only audit versus retention deletion), CHK038 (UI not covered by the guard requirement), CHK048 (credentials listed as prohibited but no detectors)
